subtasks.objective: Add an authorization guard to release_tables_after_print(invoice) so a caller can only release tables for invoices they are permitted to act on, scoped to the invoice's branch/table cluster.
subtasks.acceptance: release_tables_after_print rejects unauthorized invoice/table-release attempts, continues to release the occupied table cluster for authorized callers, and has focused coverage or a documented manual verification for both authorized and unauthorized paths.
